MIND. [1] [Bar. m.]
In every form of mania, as soon as the sexual desire is increased.
Great anxiety, with pressure in stomach, nausea and retching ; has to bend double.
   

OUTER HEAD. [4] [Bar. m.]
Tinea capitis extending to sides and posterior portion of neck.
   

SIGHT AND EYES. [5] [Bar. m.]
Eyeballs much inflamed. θ Scrofulous ulcers.
Ophthalmia scrofulosis.
   

LOWER FACE. [9] [Bar. m.]
Enlarged, indurated and painful submaxillary glands. θ Otorrhœa.

   

PALATE AND THROAT. [13] [Bar. m.]
Elongation of uvula, with hyperemia and blennorrhœa. θ Angina tonsillaris.
Angina tonsillaris, with suppuration, after every cold, with variola or varioloid.
Disposition to tonsillitis, with suppuration each time after taking cold.
   

SCROBICULUM AND STOMACH. [17] [Bar. m.]
Great indigestion.
Inflammation of stomach.
   

RESPIRATION. [26] [Bar. m.]
Attacks of anxious dyspnœa ; rolls on floor, several attacks a day, also in night. θ Epilepsy, with full consciousness.
   

COUGH. [27] [Bar. m.]
Chronic cough of scrofulous children.
   

INNER CHEST AND LUNGS. [28] [Bar. m.]
Blennorrhœa of lungs with scrofula.
   

NECK AND BACK. [31] [Bar. m.]
Enlargement and induration of cervical glands. θ Otorrhœa.
   

TISSUES. [44] [Bar. m.]
Affection of lymphatic vessels and glands in scrofula.
Painful glandular swellings and indurations of scrofulous people.
   

SKIN. [46] [Bar. m.]
Scrofulous eruptions.
   

STAGE OF LIFE, CONSTITUTION. [47] [Bar. m.]
Scrofulous children. See 13, 27, 31.
